interface-layers.title: Write against the interface, pick the MCU at build time
interface-layers.alt: Layer diagram: drivers, handlers and board HALs call the abstract Base interfaces such as BaseGpio, BaseI2c, BaseSpi and BaseCan; below them the ESP32 classes implement the interfaces with ESP-IDF, the STM32 classes with STM32Cube HAL handles, and host classes serve tests.
interface-layers.description: From top to bottom. Drivers, handlers and board HALs hold references to the abstract Base* classes (listed from inc/base/). Each platform folder under inc/mcu/ implements them with that platform's SDK: ESP32 classes over ESP-IDF, STM32 classes over STM32Cube HAL handles, and host classes for tests. The application picks one platform at build time; nothing above the interface line changes.
